rules: A task is passed only when its verify command exits 0 (run by harness/run_tasks.py).
Metrics come from artifacts/*.json written by real runs; never type a measured number by hand.
External services (Nebius, Tavily, PayPal Sandbox, Slack, Mattermost) are called only when their credentials are present in the environment.

tasks.title: Obsidian brain vault, canvas and colour groups
acceptance: brain/.obsidian/graph.json defines tag colour groups #agent purple, #core cyan, #adapter orange, #benchmark green
brain/AegisFlow_Architecture.canvas is valid JSON Canvas linking Sub-Agents -> Core -> Adapters -> Benchmarks
every node note carries status, latency_ms, last_verified and git_commit frontmatter

tasks.title: Claude Code sub-agents, quality hooks and settings
acceptance: .claude/agents defines systems-architect, core-builder, qa-reviewer and telemetry-ui
.claude/hooks/verify_no_stubs.sh and post_task_brain_sync.sh parse and are wired in .claude/settings.json
tasks.verify: bash -n .claude/hooks/verify_no_stubs.sh && bash -n .claude/hooks/post_task_brain_sync.sh && python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json')); assert s['hooks']['PostToolUse'] and s['hooks']['SubagentStop']" && ls .claude/agents/systems-architect.md .claude/agents/core-builder.md .claude/agents/qa-reviewer.md .claude/agents/telemetry-ui.md

tasks.title: Train and export AegisWorkflowFP16.mlpackage -> .mlmodelc
acceptance: FP16 ML Program with a 64-feature input and a 0..100 risk_score output
compiled .mlmodelc present; CoreML FP16 output matches the NumPy FP32 reference within 1.0 score point

tasks.title: aegis-storage: clonefile branches, RENAME_SWAP commit, Drop rollback
acceptance: Workspace::branch uses clonefile(CLONE_NOFOLLOW | CLONE_NOOWNERCOPY) on APFS
Branch::commit swaps trees with renameatx_np(RENAME_SWAP) and keeps the old tree as a version
dropping an uncommitted branch leaves the live tree byte-identical

tasks.title: aegis-governance: Cedar 4.x rules, redaction, ed25519 receipts
acceptance: policies/aegis_rules.cedar validates against policies/aegis.cedarschema
decision matrix covers low-risk permit, >$50 order without receipt forbid, high-impact without approval forbid
c2pa:ed25519 receipts verify and fail on tampered payloads

tasks.title: aegis-ane-scorer: Swift @_cdecl CoreML bridge + feature extraction
acceptance: aegis_ane_score_workflow scores a 64-feature vector through CoreML with .cpuAndNeuralEngine
scores match models/parity_vectors.json within 1.0 point; MLComputePlan report is readable

tasks.title: adapter-nebius-nemotron: 3-tier build recovery router
acceptance: tier-0 routing uses ANE + Cedar only
patches are applied and verified inside a fresh CoW branch; failures roll back
Nebius/Tavily are called only when NEBIUS_API_KEY / TAVILY_API_KEY are set

tasks.title: adapter-paypal: Sandbox Orders v2 middleware + dashboard rows
acceptance: outbound order bodies contain [REDACTED] instead of sensitive strings
custom_id carries a verifiable c2pa:ed25519 signature; Cedar budget rules gate submission
AG Grid and Bryntum row exports are produced

tasks.title: adapter-switch-mcp: MCP server + Mattermost/Slack approval cards
acceptance: aegis-mcp answers initialize, tools/list and tools/call over stdio JSON-RPC
approval cards render the workspace diff for Mattermost and Slack; posting happens only with configured webhooks

tasks.title: Kiro specs: requirements, design, implementation plan
acceptance: .kiro/specs/aegisflow-phase1/requirements.md uses EARS acceptance criteria
tasks.md mirrors TASKS.json verification state

tasks.title: No-stub gate: zero TODO/FIXME/unimplemented!/hardcoded metrics
acceptance: verify_no_stubs.sh exits 0 on the whole tree

tasks.title: Release test suite
acceptance: cargo test --release --workspace exits 0
